items.html: A left-hand batsman, Ashok Menaria captained the India Under-19 team which toured Australia in 2009, recording a 2-1 win in the one-dayers. He was retained captain for the U-19 World Cup in New Zealand the following year. It was a disappointing tournament for India, going down to Pakistan in the quarter-finals. After the tournament, he bagged an IPL contract with Royal Challengers Bangalore, and later with Rajasthan Royals in IPL 2012.

He also led Rajasthan in the U-19 Cooch Behar Trophy and Vinoo Mankad Trophy in 2008-09. Menaria made his first class debut for Rajasthan the same season.
